name: Medium
weakness: No code syntax highlighting/math; no search or bulk edit; weak stats; SEO equity accrues to Medium

name: dev.to
weakness: Rented platform; no ownership of SEO; weak content mgmt/analytics; KaTeX only via liquid tag

name: Hashnode
main_promise: Dev blog w/ custom domain + LaTeX + code
weakness: Signs of neglect since late 2024 (no changelog; slow support; indexing issues); some features paid by mid-2026

name: Substack
weakness: Newsletter-first not code/math/series docs; weak technical formatting (no math info found)

name: Ghost
weakness: Value tied to theme ecosystem; friction with custom frontends; comments basic

name: WordPress
weakness: Plugin sprawl; security updates; poor Git workflow; comment spam

name: Hugo/Astro/Jekyll static sites
main_promise: Own your content in Git; fast; free
weakness: Every typo fix needs a PR; non-technical contributors locked out; comments must be bolted on

name: giscus
main_promise: Free ad-free comments stored in GitHub
weakness: GitHub login required (filters non-devs); moderation lives in GitHub UI not blog

name: utterances
weakness: GitHub-only auth; simpler features than Discussions

name: Disqus
weakness: Ad-supported free tier; privacy/behavioral ads; best features paid

name: Remark42
weakness: You run Docker/auth/backups; ops overhead

name: Isso / Cusdis
weakness: No modern anti-spam (Isso); Cusdis states no spam filter, tight free tier

name: Hyvor Talk
main_promise: Managed comments w/ real moderation + GDPR
weakness: Paid after 14-day trial

name: GitHub 'Edit this page' (Docusaurus/Starlight)
main_promise: Drive-by fixes via PR in minutes
weakness: Needs GitHub account + Git literacy; big rewrites hard to review; no credit/reputation layer

name: Hypothesis
main_promise: Inline public annotations on any page
weakness: Annotations live outside the post; not merged back into content; (limited evidence found re dev-blog use)

name: Doc freshness metadata (last-reviewed frontmatter + automation)
main_promise: Track last reviewed/by whom; auto-open issues
weakness: Used for internal docs; manual; not reader-facing for blogs

name: Stack Overflow
weakness: Answers outdated; questions down ~75% since 2014 as AI absorbs Q&A

name: Wispr Flow
weakness: Dictation not structuring; high CPU; fuzzy privacy; support slow

name: Voicenotes
main_promise: Record voice then generate blog posts/lists
weakness: Generic notes app; no code/math/series/publish pipeline

name: Superwhisper
main_promise: Offline AI dictation w/ modes + custom vocab
weakness: General dictation; not publishing-aware

name: Remotion + Claude Code skill
weakness: Needs code understanding to fix bugs; slow local render (frame screenshots); poor for one-offs

name: Motion Canvas / Revideo
weakness: Revideo folded into Midrender 2026; imperative API; ecosystem smaller
